caption: The drawing depicts a pair of light-colored stockings or socks, finely detailed with zigzag and geometric embroidered patterns running vertically along the sides. The stockings are predominantly a pale beige or cream shade, and one stocking is laid out to reveal its intricate decoration as well as some stitch lines around the toe and heel. Beneath and partially overlapping the stockings are two folded handkerchiefs or linen cloths of a similarly light color, each with red lines near the edge, forming a border. One cloth bears the initials “C B” stitched in blue in one corner, and the number “41” stitched in red. The composition presents the stockings and cloths neatly arranged on a plain, off-white background with minimal shading.
title: Stockings
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
